name: Personal Custom App policy
description: Establish the repository-wide product policy that dodo Crypto Wealth OS is built as a single-owner personal dodo Custom App and project that policy into Concept and AGENTS.md.
gate: Concept and AGENTS.md consistently declare the personal Custom App scope, local-first security boundary, and HIL requirement for multi-user or public-product expansion.
done_criteria: AGENTS.md declares personal dodo Custom App as the default product form and forbids unapproved multi-user or public SaaS expansion
Concept overview declares a single-owner personal Custom App with Custom UI and Custom Action as the default delivery form
Common requirements define local-first personal scope and require HIL before multi-user, public SaaS, hosted custody, or third-party commercialization
JSON parsing and targeted text assertions pass for all changed governance artifacts
blocking_findings: Standard workflow, Operation catalog, and SDT layout contract are not initialized; agn.route_next selected adaptive mode
